props.content: Compaction should hand over *working state*, not just shorten the chat. A small model writes the summary; persistent memory stays separate.

props.title: How a summary gets made
props.deck: The order matters: facts are saved before the old text is replaced.
props.takeaway: The summary is only as good as the facts saved before it.

props.caption: From a full session to a summary that replaces the old messages.

edges: fit --> pi : too large, use session model

beats.text: **Trigger.** Pi prepares a compaction when context passes its threshold, and picks the span to summarise.
**Memory first.** OptMem saves durable facts, then removes its wake message so the summary never contains it. The compaction extension must run after OptMem.
**Fit check (proposed).** Estimate input as characters divided by four, add the prior summary and about 1.5K of prompt. Skip Haiku if the estimate times 1.2 plus the output budget passes 200K.
**Summarise.** Haiku gets Pi's own structured prompt plus a few supplemental instructions, then writes the summary.
**Replace.** Pi swaps the old span for the summary and keeps the recent tail. A later session gets the memory wake view.

props.title: Proposed fit policy
props.code:
estimatedInputTokens = serializedMessageCharacters / 4
                     + priorSummaryTokens
                     + approximately 1500 prompt tokens
outputBudget = min(floor(0.8 * reserveTokens), model.maxTokens)
too_large = estimatedInputTokens * 1.2 + outputBudget > model.contextWindow
props.caption: The estimator is a proposed safeguard, not a verified exact tokenizer.

props.content: Keep the saved prior summary fixed across arms. Original pass bar: Haiku scores at least 90% of baseline, and no category scores zero on three or more spans. Report results by baseline model and include summary length. Keep raw session spans local and out of git.

props.deck: The review limits the work to small changes.

rows.body: Cache misses and history mismatch outweigh unproven savings.

rows.title: Re-inject files, AGENTS.md or todos
rows.body: The agent can reread files, AGENTS.md stays in the system prompt, and no todo tool is installed.

rows.title: Use a 1M-window trigger with Haiku
rows.body: A 100K reserve makes inputs too big for a 200K summariser.

props.content: Do not build normal-context masking, file or todo re-injection, or a new handoff system. Keep Pi's iterative structured prompt. The review allows logging actual sizes first if the fit check grows. On a Claude CLI subscription, the practical gain is speed and usage-limit headroom, not dollar savings.
